annotations.title: Buy a plan, plan change, renewal or add-on

description:
COSTS MONEY: Buy a plan, plan change, renewal or add-on

Charges the order from your balance (`payment.method` `balance`) or a stored card (`stripe`, optionally with `paymentMethodId`), then books it, as the plan and add-on dialogs do. Check the price with `GET /billing/orders/preview` first. If the bank asks for confirmation the status is `requires_action` and nothing is charged; pay from the balance or book in the dashboard then.

body.description: The request fields as one JSON object.

kind.description: `subscription_book` a new plan, `subscription_change` another plan, `subscription_renew` the running term again, `addon` extra minutes or conversations.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. EchoCall then answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat the call with the same arguments and this value.

name: place_order
title: Buy a plan, plan change, renewal or add-on
